name: Gingerbread Cheesecake Cups
description: Creamy no-bake cheesecake layered with spiced gingerbread crumbs.
instructions: Beat cream cheese, yogurt, sugar and spice until smooth.
Crush biscuits and divide between two glasses.
Layer with cheesecake mixture and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Soft Indian milk dumplings soaked in fragrant cardamom syrup.
instructions: Simmer sugar, water and crushed cardamom for 8 minutes; keep syrup warm.
Mix milk powder, flour and baking soda; add milk gradually to make a soft dough and shape small smooth balls.
Fry on low-medium heat until deep golden, then soak in warm syrup for at least 1 hour.

name: Peppermint Bark Brownies
description: Fudgy chocolate brownies topped with peppermint and white chocolate.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch pan.
Whisk melted butter, sugar and eggs; fold in flour and cocoa.
Bake 20–25 minutes, cool, then drizzle with melted white chocolate and sprinkle peppermint candy.

name: Gajar Ka Halwa
description: A comforting North Indian carrot pudding scented with cardamom.
instructions: Simmer carrots and milk in a heavy pan, stirring, until most liquid evaporates.
Stir in sugar, ghee and cardamom; cook until glossy and thick.
Serve warm topped with pistachios.

name: Cranberry Orange Shortbread
description: Buttery shortbread flecked with tart cranberries and bright citrus.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, then mix in flour, zest and cranberries.
Shape into a log and chill 30 minutes; slice into rounds.
Bake at 325°F for 15–18 minutes until edges are lightly golden.

name: Rasmalai
description: Soft paneer patties in saffron-cardamom sweetened milk.
instructions: Knead drained soft paneer until smooth and form small flat patties.
Gently simmer patties in lightly boiling water until firm and cooked through, about 10–12 minutes; drain.
Reduce milk with sugar, saffron and cardamom; cool, add patties and chill before serving with pistachios.

name: Brown Butter Chai Snowball Cookies
description: Nutty powdered-sugar cookies with warming chai spices.
instructions: Brown butter and cool until spreadable.
Mix with sugar, flour, almonds and spice; shape into balls.
Bake at 350°F for 12–14 minutes, cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar.

name: Kesar Pista Kulfi
description: Dense Indian saffron and pistachio frozen milk dessert.
instructions: Simmer milk until reduced by about one-third, stirring frequently.
Stir in condensed milk, saffron, cardamom and pistachios; cool.
Pour into molds and freeze for at least 6 hours.

name: Pistachio Rose Shortbread Stars
description: Delicate star-shaped cookies with pistachio and floral rosewater.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, then mix in flour, pistachios and rosewater.
Chill dough 20 minutes, roll out and cut into stars.
Bake at 350°F for 11–13 minutes.

name: Shahi Tukda
description: Crisp fried bread topped with rich saffron milk and nuts.
instructions: Simmer milk, sugar and saffron until slightly thickened.
Cut bread into triangles and toast in ghee until crisp and golden.
Spoon warm saffron milk over bread and garnish with nuts; serve promptly.

name: Red Velvet Crinkle Cookies
description: Vibrant cocoa cookies with snowy powdered-sugar cracks.
instructions: Mix flour, cocoa and baking powder; separately whisk egg, sugar, oil and coloring.
Combine, chill 30 minutes and roll dough into balls coated generously in powdered sugar.
Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes.

name: Coconut Ladoo
description: Tender Indian coconut sweets with cardamom and condensed milk.
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened desiccated coconut, plus extra
instructions: Warm ghee, coconut and condensed milk in a pan over low heat.
Stir until the mixture holds together; add cardamom and cool slightly.
Roll into small balls and coat with extra coconut.

name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
description: Warm date sponge with a silky brown-butter toffee sauce.
instructions: Soak dates in boiling water and baking soda for 10 minutes; mash.
Mix dates with flour, egg and 1 tbsp sugar; bake in greased ramekins at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.
Simmer butter, remaining sugar and cream into a sauce; pour over warm cakes.

name: Moong Dal Halwa
description: Rich golden lentil halwa slow-cooked with ghee and cardamom.
instructions: Soak dal for 3 hours, drain and grind into a coarse paste.
Cook paste in ghee over low heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and golden.
Slowly add warm milk, sugar and cardamom; stir until thick and top with cashews.

name: Chocolate Orange Yule Log
description: Rolled chocolate sponge with orange cream and chocolate frosting.
instructions: Whip eggs and sugar until thick, fold in flour and cocoa, and spread in a lined shallow pan.
Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes; roll warm sponge in parchment and cool.
Unroll, spread with whipped cream and orange zest, reroll and coat with melted-and-cooled chocolate.

name: Besan Ladoo
description: Roasted chickpea-flour sweets with ghee, cardamom and nuts.
instructions: Roast besan in ghee over low heat, stirring, until deeply fragrant and golden, about 15–20 minutes.
Cool until just warm, then mix in powdered sugar, cardamom and almonds.
Shape into balls and let set.

name: Peppermint Hot Chocolate Tiramisu
description: Layers of cocoa-dipped biscuits and peppermint mascarpone cream.
instructions: Fold mascarpone, whipped cream, sugar and peppermint extract together.
Briefly dip ladyfingers in cooled hot chocolate and layer with cream in cups.
Chill for at least 2 hours and dust with cocoa.

name: Phirni
description: Creamy Indian ground-rice pudding infused with saffron and cardamom.
instructions: Soak rice 20 minutes, drain and grind coarsely.
Simmer ground rice in milk, stirring, until thick and cooked through.
Add sugar, saffron and cardamom; chill in bowls and top with pistachios.

name: Cranberry White Chocolate Blondies
description: Chewy vanilla bars studded with cranberries and white chocolate.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch square pan.
Mix butter, sugar, egg and vanilla; fold in flour, cranberries and chips.
Bake 22–27 minutes until just set; cool before slicing.

name: Jalebi
description: Crisp spiral Indian sweets dipped in cardamom sugar syrup.
instructions: Mix flour, yogurt, baking powder and water into a thick piping batter; rest 30 minutes.
Simmer sugar, water and cardamom into a lightly sticky syrup.
Pipe spirals into medium-hot oil, fry crisp and dip briefly in warm syrup.

name: Salted Caramel Gingerbread Cheesecake
description: Spiced no-bake cheesecake topped with salted caramel.
instructions: Mix crushed biscuits with butter and press into small serving glasses.
Beat cream cheese, whipped cream, sugar and spices; spoon over crumbs.
Chill 30 minutes, then top with caramel and a little flaky salt.

name: Mysore Pak
description: A rich South Indian sweet made with gram flour, ghee and sugar.
instructions: Sift besan and grease a small tray; keep ghee warm.
Boil sugar and water until slightly syrupy, then stir in besan gradually.
Add warm ghee a little at a time, stirring until mixture turns porous and leaves the pan; spread in tray and cut while warm.

name: Spiced Pear Almond Tartlets
description: Flaky pastry cups filled with almond cream and cinnamon pears.
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F; cut pastry into six squares and score a border on each.
Mix almonds, butter, sugar and yolk; spread within borders and top with thin pear slices.
Dust with cinnamon and bake 20–25 minutes until golden.

name: Rabri with Rose and Pistachio
description: Slow-reduced Indian milk dessert with rose, cardamom and pistachios.
instructions: Simmer milk in a wide heavy pan, scraping the sides and stirring, until reduced by about half.
Add sugar, cardamom and saffron; cook 5 minutes more and cool.
Stir in rosewater, chill and garnish with pistachios.
